reading_note: The arc moves from the state of falsity-from-evil (night/darkness) that fills the natural mind, through the fivefold operation of divine truth (sun) — illumination, beauty, peace, deliverance of the living soul, and empowerment of the elements — into three deeper types revealing the Father of Greatness Himself: the hidden disc (the inexhaustibility of celestial good), the exalted light (transcendence of all received truths), and the exalted height (the Lord raised above all spiritual states). The teaching closes by reading day and night as a daily visible correspondence: the sun = the unburied Father revealed, the night/shadow = the mystery of darkness recognized through evils. The single arc: how the daily cycle of natural light and darkness is itself a perpetual revelation of the Lord and of the opposing falsity, so that men may recognize both mysteries through what is constantly before their eyes.
